jobs.occupation: Finance Controller Foods DACH (d/f/m) (Controller/in)
jobs.description: Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027. Finance Controller Foods DACH (d/f/m)The Finance Controller Foods DACH is the senior finance leader accountable for the integrity of financial accounting and reporting, the effectiveness of the risk and control environment, and the quality of internal and external assurance across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. The role safeguards the financial health and compliance of the DACH legal entities and provides clear financial judgement and constructive challenge to senior Finance and business stakeholders. The role will be integral in establishing and implementing new processes locally to meet the reporting requirements of the planned combined business with McCormick, including compliance with the reporting calendar, US GAAP accounting standards and SOX control frameworks. The Finance Controller is also responsible for the continuous development of the local controlling organization.  You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet. Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead internal and external audits; act as main contact for the local external auditor and Corporate Audit and own all follow-up actions - Ensure the Financial Controls Framework (incl. SOX) is embedded in line with the global model, including controls operated outside Finance (e.g. Supply Chain), and drive remediation where controls are not operating - Proactively lead the risk management agenda, ensuring high-quality risk assessments and appropriate mitigation - Ensure accurate and timely group and local statutory reporting, own the integrity of the DACH balance sheets, including timely substantiation and resolution of material exposures, and ensure high-quality delivery across Record to Report, Procure to Pay and Order to Cash - Continuously improve accounting quality, implement changes in group & local standards and establish the local processes required for reporting in the planned combined business, working with the central Reporting & Accounting Operations team to upskill local teams (e.g. lease accounting under US GAAP) - Oversee statutory accounting, filing and governance requirements for the DACH legal entities, including Supervisory Board papers, in coordination with local directors, auditors, Tax, Legal, Treasury and Pension specialists - Oversee Treasury operations and local bank relations in line with the Global Treasury Standard, and implement required risk control and insurance standards - Act as a trusted adviser to DACH Finance and business leadership on accounting, reporting, risk and control matters, providing constructive challenge, translating complex topics into clear recommendations and holding senior stakeholders to account for timely resolution of risks - Lead, coach and develop the local Controlling team, setting clear priorities, accountabilities and performance expectations - Build capability in accounting, US GAAP, statutory reporting, SOX and risk management, and foster a culture of ownership, integrity and continuous improvement  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years of Finance experience, including financial accounting, reporting and controls in an international organisation - Strong expertise in financial accounting, internal controls and risk management, including SOX or comparable control frameworks - US GAAP experience, or the ability to implement US GAAP requirements with specialist support - Strong knowledge of German statutory accounting and governance requirements, with a working understanding of tax matters - Good understanding of German pension accounting, reporting and governance requirements - Experience managing internal and external audits and driving remediation of findings - Proven people leadership, including delivering outcomes through cross-functional stakeholders - Strong judgement and clear communication, with the ability to explain complex financial matters to non-Finance audiences - Fluency in German and English  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent) - Experience across Germany, Switzerland and Austria - SAP S/4HANA experience WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great! We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. Support us in shaping the future with courage and common sense!Your tasks: You make the difference with us.- Plan, execute, and optimize  online paid social campaigns  at scale to achieve CDR and ROI targets.- Implement  campaign tracking set-up  as well as a structured  test-and-learn approach  to drive continuous performance improvement.- Regular reports on  campaign performance  , test results, and forecasts are created independently – including  in-depth analysis  .- Promotions and sale campaigns are executed in close collaboration with Marketing and Category Management.- You coordinate  cross-functional projects  and stay connected within the industry to anticipate  trends  early and discuss valuable learnings.Your profile: You keep reinventing us.- At least  5 years of online marketing experience  are part of your background, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Paid Social (Meta, Pinterest, TikTok) in a fast-paced e-commerce company.- Fluent in  English  ; German language skills are highly desirable.- Resilient  by nature – you stay focused and deliver results even when things get demanding.- Multiple  stakeholder  requests are managed and prioritized by you independently, without the need for manager intervention.- Building and  sustaining long-term partnerships comes naturally to you, backed by strong  relationship management skills  .- A deep understanding of  tracking, data, and forecasting  is part of your toolkit, along with a solid grasp of the cross-channel digital advertising ecosystem.- Staying on top of industry trends, market practices, and emerging standards genuinely excites you.- With a  proactive, self-starter mentality  , you drive projects and improvements from scratch – with minimal guidance needed.Your benefits: Together we stay different.- Enjoy  30 days of vacation  ,  flexible working hours  , and the option to  work hybrid  . We also offer you the freedom to work up to  10 days per year from within the EU  .- Benefit from the  excellent transport links  to our headquarters, a  travel allowance  for the Deutschlandticket, and the option to lease a  company bike  .- Take advantage of our  wide range of training opportunities  for your personal development: e-learning, internal and external seminars and workshops.- We offer you a comprehensive  GenAI Suite  with access to all common LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and many more) in a secure environment – and a strong  AI community  by your side.- You will receive an  employee discount  on all Tchibo products and a monthly  package of Tchibo coffee  of your choice for your personal enjoyment.- There is something for every taste: with a  restaurant  ,  bistro  ,  cafeteria  , and  free drinks  , you are well looked after. And at Christmas, there is the Tchibo  Christmas roast  - also available as a vegan option.- In our leisure centre, you can keep fit with our  fitness room  ,  swimming pool  , and  sports courses  .- We offer  childcare during school holidays  ,  family services  , and some  company-owned daycare spots  – so that you can balance your professional and personal life with ease.- Through our  Corporate Benefits  programme, you can purchase a wide range of products and services at reduced prices.Our job suits you? Then we look forward to your application! It's super fast: register, upload attachments, answer our motivational questions - done. No cover letter needed!Your contact person is Benjamin Rohden. You have questions? Simply contact our recruiting support at +49 40 6387 3353.ID 59496

jobs.occupation: Offshore Servicetechniker (w/m/d) Deutsche Bucht (78763) (Elektroniker/in - Betriebstechnik)
jobs.description: Du möchtest hoch hinaus? Wir bieten Dir die Möglichkeit dazu!Als Weltmarktführer im Bereich Windenergie verantwortet Vestas den Service an den innovativsten Windenergieanlagen und bietet dir viele Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Als Servicetechniker (m/w/d) erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in der Welt der Erneuerbaren Energien!Service>Service Offshore NCE>Service DK & DE>Deutsche BuchtDie Vestas Service Offshore Organisation ist für alle Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit dem Betrieb und der Wartung von Offshore-Windparks in Nord- und Mitteleuropa verantwortlich.Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter die zukünftig den Offshore-Betrieb unserer Windenergieanlagen im Offshore-Windpark Nordseecluster, bestehend aus 104 V236 Windturbinen mit jeweils 15 MW und einer resultierenden Gesamtkapazität von über 1,5 GW, sicherstellen.Du wirst eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem Serviceteam übernehmen. Zeitweilige Reisen zu anderen Offshore-Windparks innerhalb von Vestas zur Schulung, Weiterbildung und zum Erfahrungsaustausch sind ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Position. Als Offshore-Servicetechniker (w/m/d) arbeitest du in einem Team von drei oder mehr Technikern und sorgst für einen reibungslosen und zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Windenergieanlagen.Deine Vorteile – Weil du es wert bist!- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag für Sicherheit und Perspektive, sofortiger Einstieg- Top-Weiterbildung in der Vestas Academy, inklusive Qualifizierung zur Elektrofachkraft nach DIN-VDE 0105-100- Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum- Intensive Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Schulungen- Arbeiten am Puls der Zeit – modernste Windenergietechnologie und innovative Lösungen- Kostenlose hochwertige Ausrüstung – alles, was du für deine Einsätze brauchst- Modernste Unterbringung auf einem SOV - inkusive Kino, Fitnessstudios und Sauna- Vollständige Verpflegung während deiner Offshore-Schicht- Attraktive Benefits: Business Bike, Fitnessstudio-Zulage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Überstundenkonto und Möglichkeit zum Sabbatical- Keine Langeweile – jeder Tag ist anders- Wertschätzung und ein starkes Team in internationaler Arbeitsatmosphäre– wir halten zusammen- Menschlichkeit und Vielfalt – wir sind ein Team und setzen auf eine offene und wertschätzende Du-Kultur Deine Mission- Pack mit an!- Wartung und Reparatur von elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen- Störungsbeseitigung an elektrischen und mechanischen Systemen- Fehlerdiagnose- Durchführung einer Vielzahl von Überprüfungen, Reparaturen und Austausch von Turbinenkomponenten- Einhaltung von HSE-Standards- Erstellen von Folgeaufträgen und Erfassen des Zeit- und Materialverbrauchs in SAP Dein Profil – du bringst mit!- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker (m/w/d)- Vorzugsweise bereits Wind- und/oder Offshore-Erfahrungen gesammelt (kein Muss)- Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift- Grundkenntnisse in Microsoft OfficeBEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUDIt has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process DEIB StatementAt Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future. About VestasVestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 173 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.With 29,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe (https://javascript:void\(0\);)  to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Offshore-Windkraftanlagen installieren und warten
